name: Hulum's Cave — Dim Path Modular Asset Kit

assets.purpose: A low-contrast, receding cavern approach with broken basalt paving, dark stone shoulders, restrained water glints and low mist.

look.keyLight: cold blue-grey, grazing from behind the threshold
look.fog: low horizontal volumetric layer; do not obscure silhouette edges

integration.blender: Import OBJ; split by group/material if separate objects are required; assign volumetric mist to LOW_MIST_CARDS.
integration.maya: Import OBJ with materials; group by OBJ object names; preserve metre scale.

canon: experimental until reviewed in a rendered scene
